text_blocks.snippet: A CVC (Card Verification Code) or CVV (Card Verification Value) is a security feature on Visa, Mastercard, and Discover cards. It's a three-digit number printed on the back of the card, usually on or near the signature strip. This code helps to verify that the person using the card during an online or phone transaction is the actual cardholder.
